main_text.p: Interdum verba, quæ actiue significant, hic conjugantur, ut נִשְׁבַּע nischbâg, juravit, נִלְחָם nilchâm, præliatus est.
main_text.head: PYAL.
Singularis Numerus.
Pluralis Numerus.

p.i: Pykkád, pykkedá, pykkádta, pykkádt, pykkádti. Pykkedú, pykkadtém, pykkadtén, pykkádnu.
Verba in Pyal sunt tantùm passiva, eorumq; usus est, ubi nomen agentis nō exprimitur. Hic prima radicalis signatur cum Kybuz, raro cum ֽ: hatephcamez, & media imprimitur dages.

page.notes: The Hebrew paradigm forms are transcribed from the scan and may contain small vowel-point errors: the diacritics above the forms are faint. The page reads "Pykkád" etc. in the Latin transliterations; the "ti" in "pykkádti" and the forms "pykkedú" are as printed. Several Latin words in the transliteration line are doubtful: "eorumq; usus est" is read as printed, with the second word reading as "usus" ([?] not added since the letters are clear enough on the scan). The Hebrew vowel marks under the first letter of the 3. C. form are uncertain. The page-number glyph at the foot is "q 4", read as a catchword-like mark and kept in the catchword element; it may instead be a signature. Show-through from the reverse side is present and was ignored.
